2002 ENV (completed before the September 2002 crisis)
historical_national_poverty_supplement_l: National relative monetary poverty line of FCFA 183,450 per person per year for the 2002 ENV; the line is revalued at each household living-standards survey to preserve its real value from the 1985 base.
historical_national_poverty_supplement_w: Per-capita household consumption expenditure; poverty incidence is the share of people whose consumption falls below the line.
historical_national_poverty_supplement_s: National ENV 2002 estimate, with results reported for the total population and urban/rural strata; the five detailed strata are Abidjan, other towns, eastern rural forest, western rural forest, and rural savannah.
historical_national_poverty_supplement_m: Survey-based national poverty headcount (P0) below the national line; 38.4% in 2002 (38.38% in the INS series).
historical_national_poverty_supplement_s: Institut National de la Statistique / Cellule de Lutte contre la Pauvreté, Enquête sur le Niveau de Vie des Ménages 2002 (ENV 2002)

2002/2003 Household Income and Expenditure Survey
historical_national_poverty_supplement_l: Basic Needs Poverty Line (BNPL): national minimum-cost-of-living threshold, defined as food poverty line plus non-food poverty line; the government report gives F$155 per week per household. Later official summaries report differentiated BNPL values by urban/rural area.
historical_national_poverty_supplement_w: Per-adult-equivalent income; headcount is the share of people whose income is below the applicable BNPL.
historical_national_poverty_supplement_s: National estimate from the Fiji HIES, including urban and rural households; the government report says poverty was concentrated more heavily in rural areas.
historical_national_poverty_supplement_m: Survey headcount below the BNPL. Fiji's state report gives 34.4%; the current Fiji Bureau of Statistics indicator table rounds the same 2002/03 HIES result to 35%. Later World Bank re-estimation reports 39.8% using its own poverty analysis, so this row preserves the contemporaneous government-reported result rather than merging unlike estimates.
historical_national_poverty_supplement_s: Fiji Bureau of Statistics / Government of Fiji, 2002/03 Household Income and Expenditure Survey; Fiji state report to CEDAW (2009)

The Fiji government report states 34.4% of the population below BNPL and defines BNPL as food plus non-food poverty lines, F$155 per week per household. The Pacific Economic Bulletin analysis identifies the 34.4% as the share of population with adult-equivalent per-capita income below BNPL, citing the 2002/03 HIES analysis prepared for UNDP (https://devpolicy.org/PEB-APPS/PEB%202007-2010/PEB22_2_50_by_2020__poverty_and_2007.pdf). The Bureau's current table rounds 2002/03 to 35%. HIES metadata identifies Bureau of Statistics as producer and national geographic coverage (https://catalog.ihsn.org/catalog/1522). A later World Bank analysis reports a method-dependent 39.8% estimate for 2002/03 (https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/541511468249704606/pdf/638420ESW0P1150isclosed0100310110FJ.pdf).
2001/02 ESAM-II (Second Senegalese Household Survey)
historical_national_poverty_supplement_l: National cost-of-basic-needs poverty line: a 26-item food basket providing 2,400 kcal/day per adult equivalent plus a non-food allowance. Thresholds were calculated separately for Dakar, other urban areas, and rural areas, and by ESAM-II stage.
historical_national_poverty_supplement_w: Per-adult-equivalent household expenditure/consumption; the headcount counts people below the applicable locality-specific overall poverty line.
historical_national_poverty_supplement_s: National estimate for ordinary households across Dakar, other urban areas, and rural areas; the ESAM-II covered 6,624 households and reported national, urban, and rural results.
historical_national_poverty_supplement_m: Survey-based national headcount. The official 2004 DPS/World Bank report gives 57.1% for persons in 2001/02; the UN Statistics Division's later ECOWAS profile rounds this to 57% and reproduces locality-specific lines and results.
historical_national_poverty_supplement_s: Direction de la Prévision et de la Statistique (DPS), Ministère de l'Économie et des Finances, and World Bank, La Pauvreté au Sénégal: de la dévaluation de 1994 à 2001-2002 (2004), summarized in UN Statistics Division ECOWAS Poverty Profile
https://unstats.un.org/unsd/publication/ecowas_poverty_profile_e.pdf;https://www.vie-publique.sn/documents/10369/rapport-synthese-deuxieme-enquete-senegalaise-menages-esam-ii-2001-2002-dps

The ECOWAS profile reports the 2001/02 ESAM-II national headcount as 57% of persons and documents the 2,400-kcal adult-equivalent cost-of-basic-needs line and locality-specific thresholds, citing the DPS/World Bank 2004 report. The official survey summary identifies the 2001-2002 field period, 6,624 sampled households, and urban/rural scope. The 57.1% value is also reported in sources reproducing DPS/World Bank results; the profile rounds to an integer.
